column1: Activity in the leisureand hospitality sector varied by District and segment; while air travel was robust overall, demandfor restaurants, hotels, and other establishments softened due to elevated prices, as well as tounusual weather conditions in certain regions. Manufacturing activity was largely unchanged, andsupply bottlenecks normalized further. Nevertheless, delivery delays for electrical components con-tinued.
